description: Is claude-haiku-5-5 good enough for grounded, abstaining answers? Same pipeline, judge and dataset; only the answering model changes.
hypothesis: H5: claude-haiku-5-5 accuracy is within 5 points of claude-sonnet-5-5 at no more than 10% of the system cost per case. H5 is rejected if haiku's accuracy is more than 5 points below sonnet's, or its cost per case is above 10% of sonnet's.
name: model-sweep
yaml:
name: model-sweep
description: Is claude-haiku-5-5 good enough for grounded, abstaining answers? Same pipeline, judge and dataset; only the answering model changes.
# Sized after the calibration probe: $0.78 remained and a sonnet case measured ~$0.011, so the full dataset fits
# (plan rule n = remaining / cost per case, capped at 60) and no subset is needed.
hypothesis: >-
  H5: claude-haiku-5-5 accuracy is within 5 points of claude-sonnet-5-5 at no more than 10% of the system
  cost per case. H5 is rejected if haiku's accuracy is more than 5 points below sonnet's, or its cost per case
  is above 10% of sonnet's.
system: rag_studio
dataset: lumen@v1
llm: true
judge: true
grid:
  model: [claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5]
gate: {min_accuracy_delta: -0.05, max_cost_ratio: 0.10}
